selection_metric: macro F1 across all three fixed labels; zero for undefined class metrics
decision_rule: argmax predicted class probability; no threshold search
interpretation: Exploratory three-class symptom bands chosen after regression results, not validated clinical categories. Only six Low students. Repeated folds reuse students; not independent confirmation. Classification splits differ from regression because they are stratified and use three folds. Do not compare classification accuracy directly with regression MAE.
